objects.name: Vidar Stealer Unmasked: Code Signing Abuse, Go Loaders and File Inflation
objects.description: A cybercrime campaign combined a loader-as-a-service framework and DLL sideloading via a Go-compiled fake MpClient.dll, a novel evasion layer combination. The post Vidar Stealer Unmasked: Code Signing Abuse, Go Loaders and File Inflation appeared first on Unit 42 .
